name: Green-lipped mussel extract
short: Generally well tolerated in most of nine osteoarthritis trials. A case report describes an allergic reaction after inhaling the powder; the mussel contains potentially allergenic proteins.
text: In a systematic review of nine clinical trials in osteoarthritis, green-lipped mussel extract was considered generally well tolerated in most of the studies. A case report describes a woman who developed immediate eye, nose and breathing symptoms after inhaling green-lipped mussel powder, and laboratory analysis identified mussel proteins that may be allergenic. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
